summary: For NETCONF through a jump host, set ANSIBLE_NETCONF_SSH_CONFIG to 1/TRUE (use ~/.ssh/config) or a config file path containing a proxycommand; the jump host must use key auth via IdentityFile or ssh-agent.
questions: How do I use a bastion with NETCONF devices?
Can my NETCONF jump host use a password?

answer_card.title: NETCONF via a bastion
answer_card.answer_md:
Set `ANSIBLE_NETCONF_SSH_CONFIG` to `1`/`TRUE` (uses `~/.ssh/config`) or an absolute path to another SSH config:
```ini
Host *
  proxycommand ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -W %h:%p jumphost-username@jumphost.fqdn.com
  StrictHostKeyChecking no
```
The jump host must use **key-based** auth: set `IdentityFile "/absolute/path/to/private-key.pem"` or use ssh-agent.
